care.summary: Clumping tropical grass grown for citronella aroma and landscape use; wants sun, heat, and drainage.
care.water: Moderate; drought-tolerant once established, water in dry spells
care.soil: Well-draining sandy loam; avoid soggy clay
care.toxicity: Not for culinary lemongrass recipes (use C. citratus); aromatic oils can irritate skin
common_issues: Leaf tip burn in extreme drought
tips: Cut back tired foliage before flush growth
care.climate_notes: Outdoor perennial in frost-free tropical/subtropical climates; pot and shelter elsewhere.
